reference.question: The angle of elevation is \(30^\circ\), and the horizontal distance is \(60\text{ m}\). What is the height of the tower (ignoring eye height)? Select the correct answer.
reference.solution:
Method 1: Tangent ratio

The tower height is \(60\times\tan 30^\circ=60\times\sqrt{3}/3=20\sqrt{3}\text{ (m)}\).
